long_biography.plain_text:
Janet Herting's career is rooted in a long-established London family enterprise. She was already its director and secretary by 1991, working alongside John Paul Herting. The company had been incorporated thirty years earlier and now operates as Hertings, supplying builders from a Southall warehouse and branches in Leeds, Warrington and Birmingham.

Its catalogue runs from fixings, screws and ironmongery to brick accessories, ventilation products, sealants and tools. Herting remained company secretary until 2023 and continues as an active director. Neil Herting now holds the majority control formerly held by John Paul Herting.
